content:
ana: Quick question — what's the current behavior if a PagerDuty alert isn't acknowledged within the escalation window? We had an alert yesterday that went to rotation A, then turned into 2 duplicate Slack threads and nobody saw the followups.

matt: If nobody ack's, PD escalates according to the escalation policy: waits X minutes then notifies next on-call. For our team the default is 15m unless overridden per-rule. Duplicates in Slack usually come from both the integration + a webhook from our alert manager.

liam: To add — the alert manager (prometheus-alertmanager) has slack configs that can post and also PD sends messages back to slack. Those two can collide if the alertmanager has repeat_interval set low.

zara: Can we shorten only the high cpu alerts to 10m and leave infra/infra-critical as 5m? We need a safer fallback for business-critical services.

matt: We can. Two actions: (1) update the PD escalation timeout on the PD rule for that service, (2) change Alertmanager route -> continue: false and group_wait/group_interval. Example PD payload we use:
```
{"service": "infra-db", "escalation_timeout": 600}
```

ana: Where do I find the PD rule to edit? I don't have org admin.

matt: dm me and I can make the change; or follow playbook: https://redwood-internal/pagerduty/playbooks/escalations
Go to PD -> Services -> infra-db -> Escalation Policy -> Edit -> set timeout.

devops-bot: NOTE: change requests to escalation policies must be approved by SRE leads per policy. Use /pd-change-request in #eng-oncall.

liam: One more Q — is there a way to stop PD from creating a new slack thread for each resend? It threads updates under original message if you pass thread_ts in the payload, but our PD integration doesn't.

zara: Yup — Alertmanager supports attaching thread_ts via the slack api. Adding `thread_key: '{{ .GroupKey }}'` to the template will thread. But PD's integration will post separately unless we route PD->Slack via the same webhook and enable threaded updates in the integration settings.

matt: Proposed next steps: 1) ana opens /pd-change-request with service and target timeout (10m) 2) I will route a short config patch to alertmanager: set group_interval=5m and add thread_key 3) we'll monitor for 24h and revert if we see dropped notifications. Sound good?

ana: Yes, I'll file the change now. tagging @sre-rotations for approval.

sre-rotations: Approved for infra-db change, FYI keep an eye on alert volume when group_interval lowered.

ana: Filed request: https://redwood-internal/changes/CR-5112 — thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: I'll push the alertmanager patch in staging and post links when done.

devops-bot: Deploy started: patch/alertmanager/threading -> staging

ana: Thanks — will follow up tomorrow morning.
